topology_reasoning.device_identification: A short one-dimensional corrugated photonic waveguide / subwavelength grating section. The black material is a continuous narrow central spine running the full footprint length, with periodic wider ribs that extend to the full footprint height.
topology_reasoning.operation: The continuous spine carries the optical mode, while the periodic ribs perturb the effective index and form a grating/metamaterial section. Its function is primarily set by the grating period, rib duty factor, rib count/total length, rib/full width, and spine width.
function_defining_knobs: rib_length_um: duty factor / longitudinal rib length
lead_gap_um: starting phase before first rib

iterations.change_made: Initial primitive model: path-extruded 0.452 um spine plus 20 rectangular full-width ribs. Stopped because IoU exceeded 0.85; remaining diff is single-pixel edge quantization.
